sources.entry: 10. Modulate - AI for voice skins and voice chat.

summary.name: Modulate
summary.one_liner: Modulate is a voice AI company offering an enterprise platform and developer APIs that analyze audio signals (tone, deepfakes, language, events) alongside speech for fraud, moderation, and conversation intelligence.
use_cases: detect fraud and impersonation in contact center calls
moderate harassment in live voice chat
monitor AI voice agents for failures
flag at-risk customers and churn signals
redact PII and PHI from call audio and transcripts
build custom audio analysis with an API
summary.what_it_does:
Modulate describes its Ensemble Listening Model as analyzing many audio signals in each utterance, combining what is said with how it is said. Its enterprise Modulate Platform lets customers describe risks such as fraud, churn, or compliance violations in plain terms and flags when they occur in conversations. The Modulate API exposes five model families, including emotion, AI music, and deepfake detection, plus transcription variants (multilingual, English fast, medical, agentic) and PII/PHI redaction. The page also lists Velma Triage models and ToxMod Triage for moderation and escalation, and says every flag traces to a specific moment in a call.</what_it_does>
<parameter name="pricing">paid
notable: Deepfake detection ranked #1 on the Hugging Face leaderboard, stated as 98.9% accuracy on synthetic audio
Ensemble Listening Model that combines transcript content with vocal delivery signals
Compliance claims: ISO 27001 processes, HIPAA-compliant practices, and a stated policy of not training on customer conversations
Integrates through APIs and webhooks with existing stacks and conversational AI voice agents
caveats: Transcription pricing starts at $0.03/hr per the page; other tier details not stated
Page is largely marketing and customer quotes; enterprise platform pricing requires a demo booking
Listed in the awesome-ai-tools list under voice-related tools with a note about voice skins and voice chat, which the page itself does not describe
